translationRepairs: On yihai the Imperial Academy asked to use student presentation fees and optics funds for institute repairs. Approved.
On yihai the Imperial Academy asked to use student presentation fees and Guangxue funds for institute repairs. Approved.
光學錢 is a Directorate student-support levy; rendering 光 as English optics is a false friend, and Guangxue restores the Chinese term.
On yihai the Directorate of Education requested that supervisory students' presentation gifts and optics fees be used for repairs and public expenses within the directorate. It was approved.
On yihai the Directorate of Education requested that supervisory students' presentation gifts and Guangxue fees be used for repairs and public expenses within the directorate. It was approved.
The literal line repeats the same false-friend optics for 光學錢; Guangxue fees matches the Chinese fund-name.
Every circuit prefecture's five-cash miscellaneous levy per mu was cut by two cash.
Every circuit prefecture's five-cash yeast levy per mu was cut by two cash.
曲錢 is the yeast/wine-曲 acreage levy, not a generic miscellaneous fee; the neighbouring sentence already names a distinct 橋道錢.
For every prefecture in every circuit the former levy of five cash per mu in miscellaneous fees is specially reduced by two cash.
For every prefecture in every circuit the former levy of five cash per mu in yeast fees is specially reduced by two cash.
The literal likewise turns 曲錢 into miscellaneous fees; yeast fees is the levy named in the Chinese.

On dingyou, former Bian prefecture military commissioner, Inspector Grand Guardian, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief Fu Xi was advanced to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with retirement and advanced to Duke of Wei.

On dingyou, former Bian prefecture military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and concurrent Attendant-in-Chief Fu Xi was advanced to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent with retirement and advanced to Duke of Wei.
檢校太尉 is honorary Grand Commandant (太尉), not Grand Guardian (太保); the proposed literal aligns with the Chinese office.
On wuxu Xia Luqi of Suizhou became grand councillor and Prince Congke of Hedong became inspector grand guardian and state duke.
On wuxu Xia Luqi of Suizhou became grand councillor and Prince Congke of Hedong became honorary Grand Commandant and state duke.
進位檢校太尉 advances Congke to honorary Grand Commandant, not inspector grand guardian.
Mingzong said: "Let Congke sit idle in another's private residence—why trouble with memorials!"
Mingzong said: "Let him sit idle in that private residence—why trouble with memorials!"
從佗私第 is 'let him sit idle at that/his private residence'; 從 is the verb 'let', not the name Congke, and 佗 is demonstrative, not 'another person's'.
On dingsi Yun reported a Khitan raid capturing over ten thousand head and people.
On dingsi Yun reported raiding the Khitan and capturing livestock by the tens of thousands.
掩襲契丹 makes Yun the raider and the Khitan the target, so the original reversal is a real error; but 頭口萬計 is livestock counted by myriads, and the proposal's 'animals and captives' invents captives.
Frontier lords fell, tribute envoys came, eastern and northern campaigns succeeded, the Khitan were broken, Yan and Zhao were secure, and Lingwu brought Gua and Sha back.

Frontier war-lords were soon destroyed, tribute interpreters came from afar; on the eastern tour Shouyin was overthrown, on the northern campaign Wang Du was wiped out; the Khitan were broken and Yan and Zhao were secure, and Lingwu brought Gua and Sha back.
東巡而守殷殪，北討而王都殲 names Shouyin and Wang Du as persons destroyed; the original English omits both names and collapses the campaigns into a vague success.

Distant wilds soon destroyed their war-lords; heavy interpreters came straight from barbarian sons; eastern tour and Yin was overthrown; northern campaign and the royal capital was taken; the Khitan were broken and Yan and Zhao were without worry; Lingwu was controlled and Gua and Sha were both recovered.

Distant wilds soon destroyed their war-lords; heavy interpreters came straight from barbarian sons; on the eastern tour Shouyin was overthrown; on the northern campaign Wang Du was wiped out; the Khitan were broken and Yan and Zhao were without worry; Lingwu was controlled and Gua and Sha were both recovered.
守殷 is the person Shouyin and 王都 is Wang Du, not Yin as a place or the royal capital.
On bingyin, Palace Workshops director Wei Su was made Luozhou prefect; Luzhou military commissioner Wang Jianli was made Grand Preceptor retired.
On bingyin, Palace Workshops director Wei Su was made Mingzhou prefect; Luzhou military commissioner Wang Jianli was made Grand Preceptor retired.
洺州 is Mingzhou; Luozhou would be 洛州. The proposed literal restores the prefecture named in the Chinese.
On xinmao Li Yu—Hanlin exequatur and vice rites minister—became rites minister.
On xinmao Li Yu—Hanlin Recipient of Edicts and Vice Minister of War—became Chamberlain for Ceremonials.
兵部侍郎 is Vice Minister of War and 太常卿 is Chamberlain for Ceremonials; both were wrongly rendered as rites posts, and 翰林承旨 is Recipient of Edicts, not exequatur.
On xinmao, Hanlin exequatur and Vice Minister of Rites Li Yu was made Minister of Rites.
On xinmao, Hanlin Recipient of Edicts and Vice Minister of War Li Yu was made Chamberlain for Ceremonials.
The literal repeats the same office errors: 兵部侍郎 and 太常卿 are not rites-ministry posts.
Yao Yanchou—escort foot commander and Chen prefect—became Shou commissioner and foot commander.
Yao Yanchou—escort foot commander and Cheng prefect—became Shou commissioner and foot commander.
澄州 is Cheng; Chen would render 陳 or 郴, which the Chinese does not have.
Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief and Chenzhou prefect Yao Yanchou was made Shouzhou military commissioner and concurrent Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief.
Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief and Chengzhou prefect Yao Yanchou was made Shouzhou military commissioner and concurrent Imperial Escort Foot Army commander-in-chief.
The literal Chenzhou likewise misreads 澄州; Chengzhou is the prefecture in the Chinese.

On gengchen, Fengguo Army military commissioner and concurrent Weiwu Army deputy military commissioner, honorary Grand Preceptor, and Palace Attendant Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Secretariat director.

On gengchen, Fengguo Army military commissioner and concurrent Weiwu Army deputy military commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, and Palace Attendant Wang Yanbin gained concurrent Secretariat director.
檢校太尉 is honorary Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor (太傅/太師).
Mingzong ordered that outgoing defense, training, and prefectural commissioners join court ranks, or stand with regular attendees if no vacancy."
Mingzong ordered that outgoing defense, training, and prefectural commissioners join court ranks, or stand with regular attendees if no vacancy.
The idiomatic sentence is an English summary of the edict, not a quotation, so the stray closing quotation mark is an error with no Chinese warrant.
On jiashen Sun Zhang became Yan commissioner.
On jiashen Sun Zhang became Fu commissioner.
鄜州 is Fu, not Yan; the repair is needed, but the parenthetical 'Fuzhou (Fu prefecture)' is awkward beside the chapter's compressed 'X commissioner' style.
On jiashen, former Qizhou defense commissioner Sun Zhang was made Yanzhou military commissioner.
On jiashen, former Qizhou defense commissioner Sun Zhang was made Fu prefecture military commissioner.

Yanzhou misreads 鄜州, which is Fu prefecture; the proposed replacement is right in substance but inserts Chinese 鄜州 into the English field, so the literal must say Fu prefecture without Chinese characters.

Doctor Duan Yan cited the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: at throne-hall investiture the prince in court dress with estate escort and officials gathered at court, received the book, and was led off—with no rite of returning to court or home.

Erudite Duan Yan cited the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: at throne-hall investiture the prince in court dress with estate escort and officials gathered at court, received the book, and was led off—with no rite of returning to court or home.
In this Court of Imperial Sacrifices context 博士 is a ritual erudite, not a medical doctor.

Doctor Duan Yan argued: according to the 《Kaiyuan Rites》, when investing kings and great ministers at the throne hall, on that day the investee in court dress with estate guard of honor and all officials gathers at the court hall, receives investiture at his place, and the protocol officer leads him off—the rites do not record returning to court or estate.

Erudite Duan Yan argued: according to the 《Kaiyuan Rites》, when investing kings and great ministers at the throne hall, on that day the investee in court dress with estate guard of honor and all officials gathers at the court hall, receives investiture at his place, and the protocol officer leads him off—the rites do not record returning to court or estate.
The literal 'Doctor' likewise misreads the office 博士 as a physician.

The office wished to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: the prince in court dress would ride from his residence with escort, gather at court, receive investiture, place the book on the carriage outside Xuande Gate, ride to the ancestral temple, then return home with the same escort.

The office wished to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: the prince in court dress would ride from his residence with escort, gather at court, receive investiture, place the book on the carriage outside Yingtian Gate, ride to the ancestral temple, then return home with the same escort.
應天門 is Yingtian Gate; Xuande Gate would be 宣德門, which the Chinese does not have.

The present office wishes to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: on that day the Prince of Qin in court dress, from his residence mounting his carriage with guard of honor, with all ministers gathering at court and receiving investiture at his place; then outside Xuande Gate placing the book on the book carriage, the prince mounting his carriage, going to pay court at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, then returning to his residence—the guard of honor as on arrival.

The present office wishes to follow the 《Kaiyuan Rites》: on that day the Prince of Qin in court dress, from his residence mounting his carriage with guard of honor, with all ministers gathering at court and receiving investiture at his place; then outside Yingtian Gate placing the book on the book carriage, the prince mounting his carriage, going to pay court at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, then returning to his residence—the guard of honor as on arrival.
The literal repeats Xuande for 應天門; Yingtian Gate is the gate named in the Chinese.
On wushen Yan reported Haizhou commander Wang Chuanzheng had killed prefect Chen Xuan, burned the city, and brought five thousand troops and families to submit at Yi."
On wushen Yan reported Haizhou commander Wang Chuanzheng had killed prefect Chen Xuan, burned the city, and brought five thousand troops and families to submit at Yi.
The idiomatic English paraphrases the memorial and has no opening quote, so the stray closing quotation mark is an English-only error.

On yichou in the ninth month Wang Hongzan of Jie said the prefecture had barely a thousand households and no counties; he tallied three thousand two hundred and asked to restore Jiangli and Fujin counties with magistrates."

On yichou in the ninth month Wang Hongzan of Jie said the prefecture had barely a thousand households and no counties; he tallied three thousand two hundred and asked to restore Jiangli and Fujin counties with magistrates.
The idiomatic line already paraphrases the memorial; the final closing quotation mark has no matching open quote and is not required by the Chinese.
Li Yun became right secretariat director;
Li Yi became right secretariat director;
李懌 is Li Yi; Yun does not romanize 懌.
Hanlin academician and acting Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yun was made Right Secretariat director;
Hanlin academician and acting Vice Minister of Revenue Li Yi was made Right Secretariat director;
The literal repeats the wrong romanization Li Yun for 李懌.
Liu Zan became censor-in-chief; Xu Guangyi became vice war minister; Yao Yan became vice personnel minister.
Liu Zan became censor-in-chief; Xu Guangyi became vice war minister; Yao Yi became vice personnel minister.
姚顗 is Yao Yi; Yan does not romanize 顗.
Secretariat aide Liu Zan was made Censor-in-chief; Censor-in-chief Xu Guangyi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of War Yao Yan was made Vice Minister of Personnel.
Secretariat aide Liu Zan was made Censor-in-chief; Censor-in-chief Xu Guangyi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of War Yao Yi was made Vice Minister of Personnel.

On guisi, Yanzhou military commissioner Mi Junli died; court was suspended.
On guisi, Fuzhou military commissioner Mi Junli died; court was suspended.
The literal Yanzhou likewise names the wrong prefecture; Fuzhou here stands for 鄜州.
On jihai Li Congzhang of Left Pillar of Majestic Valor became Shan commissioner; Liu Yancong of Shan moved to Bin.
On jihai Li Congzhang of the Left Bold Cavalry became Shan commissioner; Liu Yancong of Shan moved to Bin.
左驍衛 is the Left Bold Cavalry Guard, not a Pillar of Majestic Valor title.
On jihai Left Pillar of Majestic Valor general Li Congzhang was made Shan military commissioner; Shan military commissioner Liu Yancong was transferred to Bin.
On jihai Left Bold Cavalry senior general Li Congzhang was made Shan military commissioner; Shan military commissioner Liu Yancong was transferred to Bin.
左驍衛上將軍 is Left Bold Cavalry senior general; Pillar of Majestic Valor is not in the Chinese.
On xinhai Ma Xisheng—Wuan deputy commissioner, Hong-E route deputy commander, honorary grand preceptor—became Wuan commissioner, additionally palace attendant.
On xinhai Ma Xisheng—Wuan deputy commissioner, Hong-E route deputy commander, honorary Grand Commandant—became Wuan commissioner, additionally palace attendant.
檢校太尉 is honorary Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor.

On xinhai Wuan deputy military commissioner, Hong-E route deputy campaign commander-in-chief, and honorary grand preceptor Ma Xisheng was made Wuan military commissioner, additionally palace attendant.

On xinhai Wuan deputy military commissioner, Hong-E route deputy campaign commander-in-chief, and honorary Grand Commandant Ma Xisheng was made Wuan military commissioner, additionally palace attendant.
The literal repeats honorary grand preceptor for 檢校太尉; Grand Commandant is the office.
Eleventh month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to invest Prince Qin; guards, music suspended, and ritual as prescribed.
Eleventh month, gengshen new moon: the Emperor held audience at the Hall of Civil Splendor to invest Prince Qin; guards and the suspended ritual-music instruments followed the prescribed ceremony.
仗衛樂懸如儀 means guards and the hanging ritual-music set followed the prescribed ceremony; 樂懸 is not a cancellation of music.
On jisi the late retired crown prince junior tutor Feng Shunqing was posthumously made crown prince junior tutor.
On jisi the late retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Feng Shunqing was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
太子少保 and 太子少傅 are distinct offices; collapsing both to 'crown prince junior tutor' erases the posthumous promotion.
On jisi the late retired crown prince junior tutor Feng Shunqing was posthumously made crown prince junior tutor.
On jisi the late retired Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent Feng Shunqing was posthumously made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
The literal likewise collapses 少保 and 少傅 into one English title; Junior Guardian versus Junior Mentor restores the two offices.
On bingzi former Tong commissioner Luo Zhoujing became Left Gate of Surveillance general.
On bingzi former Tong commissioner Luo Zhoujing became General of the Left Palace Gate Guard.
監門 is the palace gate-guard; 'Gate of Surveillance' misreads 監 as surveillance rather than the gate-watch.
On dingwei Yang Renju, secretariat aide and heir of the two dynasties and Duke of E, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously made Master of Works.
On dingwei Yang Renju, secretariat aide, heir of the two dynasties, and Duke of Xi, died; court was suspended; he was posthumously made a Director in the Ministry of Works.
酅國公 is Duke of Xi, not E, and 贈工部郎中 is a posthumous Director in the Ministry of Works, not Master of Works.
On jiayin the late Xichuan army overseer and Sizhou defender Li Yan was posthumously made grand preceptor.
On jiayin the late Xichuan army overseer and Sizhou defender Li Yan was posthumously made Grand Mentor.
贈太傅 is a posthumous Grand Mentor, not Grand Preceptor (太師).
On wuwu the late Jingnan commissioner, honorary grand preceptor, concurrent minister of personnel, and King of Nanping Gao Jixing was posthumously made grand preceptor.
On wuwu the late Jingnan commissioner, honorary Grand Commandant, concurrent Director of the Department of State Affairs, and King of Nanping Gao Jixing was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

檢校太尉 and 贈太尉 are Grand Commandant, not Grand Preceptor, and 尚書令 is not Minister of Personnel; but 'Director of the Imperial Secretariat' misidentifies 尚書令 (Department of State Affairs) as the Zhongshu secretariat.
